summary.text: Fatima Muse is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
A medical family therapist and educator, she lists a Ph.D. from Saint Louis University School of Medicine.

paragraphs.text: Fatima Muse lists a Ph.D. from Saint Louis University School of Medicine (2022) and a graduate degree from Southeastern Louisiana University (2013); Ballotpedia gives her profession as mental health professional.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Muse described herself as a medical family therapist, educator, small business owner, homeowner and caregiver who was born and raised in New Orleans, has family roots in Hunt County, and now lives in Commerce.
Muse said in the survey that she would fight for fully funded public schools, affordable health care, stronger mental health resources and fiscal accountability.
She also said she would seek transparency, public notice, independent impact studies and local control over hyperscale data centers and large developments in Hunt, Hopkins and Van Zandt Counties.
She listed endorsements from the Center for Freethought Equality, Mothers Against Greg Abbott, the National Democratic Redistricting Committee and Blue Horizon Texas.
